name: ODYSSEY 15 · THE PRINCE SETS SAIL FOR HOME

rows.t: Telemachus, wake. It is wrong to wander while your house is eaten hollow. Go home now, before your mother's own kin bend her to marry Eurymachus and your inheritance walks out the door with her.

x_odyssey.speaker: character.athena
x_odyssey.payload: Athena appears to Telemachus in Sparta and orders him to return before Penelope is forced to marry
x_odyssey.direction: stands over his bed in the dark
x_odyssey.delivery: night visitor issuing urgent intelligence and a concealed return route
reveal: Athena appears to Telemachus in Sparta and orders him to return before Penelope is forced to marry

rows.t: And hear this too: the boldest of the suitors lie in ambush in the strait between Ithaca and rocky Same, hungry for your blood before you ever reach home. Keep clear of that channel, sail wide, and sail by night.

x_odyssey.speaker: character.athena
x_odyssey.payload: She warns that the suitors wait in ambush and gives a route that avoids the strait
x_odyssey.direction: urgent, tracing the route in the air
x_odyssey.delivery: night visitor issuing urgent intelligence and a concealed return route
reveal: She warns that the suitors wait in ambush and gives a route that avoids the strait

rows.t: When you touch Ithaca, send ship and crew round to the town without you. Go first, on foot, to the swineherd Eumaeus, who keeps faith with your house; sleep there, and send him to tell your mother you are safely home.

x_odyssey.speaker: character.athena
x_odyssey.payload: She tells him to land secretly and go first to Eumaeus's hut
x_odyssey.delivery: night visitor issuing urgent intelligence and a concealed return route
reveal: She tells him to land secretly and go first to Eumaeus's hut

rows.t: Menelaus, dear to Zeus, your gifts honor me and I take them gladly. But do not hold me for more feasting; my heart is already on Ithaca, and I fear what rots there while I linger.

x_odyssey.speaker: character.telemachus

x_odyssey.delivery: grateful guest now prioritizing speed over ceremony

rows.t: Take this robe, child, woven by my own hands, for the bride you will one day wed; let your mother keep it till then. And read that eagle with the white goose in its claws as I do: so Odysseus, home from long wandering, will stoop upon the suitors, or he is home already, seeding their ruin.

rows.t: So the whips came down and the horses flew, through Phera as the sun set, and on to sandy Pylos with the dawn.

rows.t: Son of Nestor, will you do me one kindness more, and drive me past your father's gates, straight down to my ship? Old Nestor's welcome is warm, but it does not let go, and I cannot lose a night to it.

x_odyssey.delivery: grateful guest now prioritizing speed over ceremony

rows.t: Aboard, men, rig the mast and run out the oars. We sail for home now, not at dawn.

x_odyssey.payload: At the Pylian harbor Telemachus orders the crew to ready the ship
x_odyssey.delivery: young captain accepting a dangerous stranger while managing rapid launch

rows.t: Friend, by your sacrifice and by the god you pour to, tell me truly who you are, and then hear me. I have killed a kinsman in Argos, and his brothers hunt my life across the islands. Take me aboard, for I am a suppliant and a seer, and I have nowhere on this earth to stand.

x_odyssey.payload: The fugitive seer Theoclymenus approaches and asks for passage after killing a kinsman
x_odyssey.direction: breathless, glancing back down the road
x_odyssey.delivery: alert fugitive seer carrying urgency, social rank, and omen sensitivity
reveal: The fugitive seer Theoclymenus approaches and asks for passage after killing a kinsman

rows.t: I will not push away a man who asks. Come aboard; you'll share what we have, and in Ithaca you will be made welcome.

x_odyssey.payload: Telemachus accepts him and places him aboard
x_odyssey.direction: takes his spear, hands him up the plank
x_odyssey.delivery: young captain accepting a dangerous stranger while managing rapid launch
reveal: Telemachus accepts him and places him aboard

rows.t: Grey-eyed Athena sent the wind astern, and the black ship ran through the dark, past Elis and the needle islands, toward Ithaca and the ambush that waited in the strait.

x_odyssey.payload: The ship leaves under Athena's wind and sails through the night toward Ithaca
x_odyssey.delivery: frame the action without replacing character agency

rows.t: At dawn, friend, I'll go down to the town and beg at the great house; perhaps the suitors need a man to carve meat and pour wine. I refuse to eat your bread another day and give nothing back.

rows.t: Tell me of old Laertes, does he still live? And the mother of Odysseus, what became of her? And you yourself, friend: what land bore you, and how did you come to serve this house?

conceal: true identity unless the source beat explicitly reveals it
reveal: The beggar asks about Laertes, Anticleia, and Eumaeus's origins

rows.t: I was a king's son once, on the island men call Syria, till a Phoenician woman of my father's house sold me to her traders for trinkets and a passage home. Seven days we ran before the wind; on the seventh she dropped dead in the hold, and they carried me on like cargo, to sell.

rows.t: Come, child. This house is yours now.

rows.t: And as the ship closed on Ithaca, a hawk, Apollo's swift messenger, swept by on the right with a dove torn in its talons, and the feathers fell between Telemachus and the sea.

x_odyssey.payload: As the ship approaches Ithaca, a hawk tears a dove beside Telemachus
x_odyssey.delivery: frame the action without replacing character agency
reveal: As the ship approaches Ithaca, a hawk tears a dove beside Telemachus

rows.t: The bird flew on your right hand, Telemachus, no house in Ithaca out-kings yours; the power stays with your line forever!

x_odyssey.payload: Theoclymenus reads the omen as proof that Odysseus's line will remain supreme

rows.t: Crew, take her round to the town harbor without me; I go inland to look over my farms. Tonight I lodge with the herdsmen, and tomorrow evening I'll set out a feast to pay you for the voyage.

rows.t: Piraeus will keep you honorably, friend, until I send for you. Trust him as you would me.
